[docs]
class HomeControllerSnapshots:

    def __init__(self, client: Client) -> None:
        self.client = client
        self._snapshots: list[HomeSnapshot] = []

    def __iter__(self):
        return iter(snap for snap in self._snapshots)

    @property
    def snap_list(self) -> list[HomeSnapshot]:
        return asyncio.run(self._get_list())

    async def _get_list(self) -> list[HomeSnapshot]:

        async def get_snapshots_list():
            async with self.client:
                snaps, err = await snapshots_home.snapshots_get(self.client, "")
            if err:
                self.log.error(f"Failed to get snapshots list: {err}")
                return []
            else:
                return snaps

        self._snapshots = [
            HomeSnapshot(
                home_id=snap.ID,
                label=snap.Label,
                updated=snap.Updated,
                updated_time=snap.UpdatedTime,
                compressed=snap.Compressed,
                devices=[x for x in snap.Devices]
            ) for snap in await get_snapshots_list()
        ]
        return self._snapshots
